{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the filter logic
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check that all rows in filtered_df are indeed 'paid_search' and 'new'
assert filtered_df['channel'].isin(['paid_search']).all(), "Some rows are not 'paid_search'"
assert filtered_df['customer_segment'].isin(['new']).all(), "Some rows are not 'new'"

# Total number of new customers reached by paid search
n = len(filtered_df)

# Number who converted
converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()

# Fraction converted
fraction = converted / n

# Verify no missing values in 'converted' for this group
assert filtered_df['converted'].isnull().sum() == 0, "Missing values in 'converted'"

fraction"}
